tone.target: dark intimate clean with subtle grit and wide reverb
tone.profile: dark intimate clean with subtle grit and wide reverb
tone.summary: A warm, intimate signal chain using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) paired with subtle compression, light overdrive for soft edge, and heavy use of Plate reverb and Tape delay to create a spacious, melancholic sound.
